chunks: Mansur ibn Hazim narrated from Abu Abdullah عليه السلام, who said:
Ali عليه السلام used to say: If the son of al-mulāʿanah dies and he has brothers, his estate is divided according to the shares ordained by Allah, the Mighty and Majestic.

key_terms.إِخْوَةٌ: brothers who may inherit from the deceased
key_terms.ابْنُ الْمُلَاعَنَةِ: the son connected to a case of li'an, or mutual imprecation between spouses
key_terms.سِهَامِ اللَّهِ: the inheritance shares ordained by Allah
key_terms.مَالُهُ: his estate or property left behind

ai.seo_question: How is the estate of the son of li'an divided if he dies and has brothers?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling on the inheritance of the son born in the case of li'an. If he dies leaving brothers, his estate is distributed according to the divinely ordained inheritance shares.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5696 - Mansur ibn Hazim narrated from Abu Abdullah (as) who said:
"Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) used to say: 'If the son of the cursed woman dies and he has brothers, his wealth is divided according to the shares ordained by Allah (swt), the Mighty and Majestic.'"
